Of a report that prevails, on which usage see Thes. vol. 4 p. 1925.
with which in Thes. vol. 4 p. 1925 an example of the opposite meaning from Arist. Av. 735 is compared: αἰσχρὰ τῷ νόμῳ κρατούμενα [shameful things held by law], i.e. prohibited, forbidden.
Thus Casaubon for κράτει [with power].
